info.title: ACR - Attack Chain Reconstruction Engine
info.description: Attack Chain Reconstruction Engine: ingest telemetry, run rule-based detection, correlate events with multi-signal scoring, reconstruct attack chains, map them to MITRE ATT&CK and evaluate against synthetic ground truth.
